interpretation: When an external colour-independent cell correspondence exists, worst-cell validation distinguishes a valid shared appearance look from a cell-shuffled confound even though the pooled source and target colour multisets are identical. This is a connectivity prior, not a method for inferring cells or identifying the physical operator.
allowed_next: audit current rights-cleared data for externally observed same-look/different-content cells
use the gate only when cell identity is independent of image colour and target style
retain identity or stock-global hard fallback when connectivity is absent
forbidden: infer cells from RGB, histograms, CLIP, source, scanner or uploader and call them content truth
treat the synthetic pass as real-film operator identification
train a router or per-cell experts on current stock pixels
promote a product or calibrated claim
claim_ceiling: synthetic evidence that externally supplied colour-independent content-cell connectivity can veto a pooled appearance shortcut
